teaser.en: Pick up a piece of its wood and you'll understand the name: mremero means 'heavy'.
teaser.sw: Okota kipande cha mbao zake na utaelewa jina lake: mremero linamaanisha 'nzito'.
teaser.dg: Uchihala chipande cha muhi uhu, undamanya mana ya dzinare: *mremero* rina mana ya 'chitu chiziho'.

summary.en: *Mremero* is a small tree of coastal and riverine forest with ash-like leaves and small yellow fruits. It is known for its heavy wood, which gives the tree its name.
summary.sw: *Mremero* ni mti mdogo wa misitu ya pwani na ya kando ya mito wenye majani yanayofanana na ya mti wa *ash* na matunda madogo ya njano. Unajulikana kwa mbao zake nzito, ambazo ndizo zilizoupa mti huu jina lake.
summary.dg: *Mremero* ni muhi mdide wa matsaka ga pwani na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, wenye makodza ganayoigana na ga muhi wa *ash* na matunda madide ga rangi ya mandano. Unamanyikana kpwa nyama za muhi ndziho, ambazo ndizo zinazoupha dzinare.

about.en: *Mremero* is a small tree with pinnate leaves that look rather like those of an ash tree. It bears small yellow fruits. Its wood is notably heavy.
about.sw: *Mremero* ni mti mdogo wenye majani yaliyogawanyika kama manyoya ambayo yanafanana kiasi na ya mti wa *ash*. Huzaa matunda madogo ya njano. Mbao zake ni nzito kwa namna ya pekee.
about.dg: *Mremero* ni muhi mdide wenye makodza madide manji ganayolungana kanda mbiri za mlita, ganayoigana chidide na ga muhi wa *ash*. Unatsukula matunda madide ga rangi ya mandano. Nyama za muhi ni ndziho sana.

where.en: It grows in coastal and riverine forest.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani na ya kando ya mito.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani na ga kanda-kanda ya miho.

uses.en: The wood is heavy; no other particular use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Mbao zake ni nzito; hakuna matumizi mengine maalumu yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Nyama za muhi ni ndziho; takuna matumizi ganjina garigoandikpwa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mremero*, meaning 'heavy', for its wood. No Swahili or English name is recorded; botanists know it as *Lecaniodiscus fraxinifolius*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mremero*, linalomaanisha 'nzito', kwa sababu ya mbao zake. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanaujua kama *Lecaniodiscus fraxinifolius*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mremero*, ririro na mana ya 'chiziho', kpwa sababu ya nyama za muhi. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi a mimea anauiha *Lecaniodiscus fraxinifolius*.

reason.en: Another member of the soapberry family
reason.sw: Mwanafamilia mwingine wa familia ya soapberry

reason.en: Also named for a property of its wood
reason.sw: Pia umepewa jina kutokana na sifa ya mbao zake
reason.dg: Nao piya dzinare rinakula kpwa tabiya ya nyama za muhi
Muhi wanjina wenye nyama za muhi ngumu na ndziho
